sources.role: higher JARVIS security, authority, semantic-proof and continuity foundation
T20 candidate subjected to this lesson gate

preGateFinding.reason: The pre-gate T20 branch diverged from and was seven commits behind the higher v1.4.0 foundation. Merging it as-is would reintroduce caller-asserted quality gates, configuration-as-live capability claims, weak non-consuming permits and unanchored learning state already repaired by v1.4.0.
preGateFinding.action: Preserve the old head, rebuild T20 additively on v1.4.0, and stack PR 548 on PR 546 rather than weakening or duplicating existing controls.

lessons.lesson: Lock the requested objective, deliverable form and expected state delta; deny weaker terminal substitutions.
lessons.control: TwentyMinuteGovernor.build_plan.objectiveLock

lessons.lesson: Keep designed, implemented, tested, published, connected, authorized, deployed, read-back and proven states separate.
lessons.control: BUILD_CONTRACT states plus proof-bearing release decision

lessons.lesson: Record success, failure, blocked, no-op and unverified states per route; one failed lane must not erase successful routes.
lessons.control: RouteResult and review_cycle route accounting

lessons.lesson: The first zero-delta route opens a no-op circuit and prohibits unchanged retry.
lessons.control: review_cycle.noOpCircuitOpened

lessons.lesson: Use action-specific semantic canaries and readback; generic transport success is non-promoting.
lessons.control: typed QualityEvidence with semantic digest and source class

lessons.lesson: Deployment source or workflow is not provider authority or deployment proof.
lessons.control: v1.4 CapabilityFabric, external effect boundary and BUILD_CONTRACT

lessons.lesson: Refresh current identity, source, metadata and proof before consequential work; stale proof expires.
lessons.control: QualityEvidence observedAt freshness validation

lessons.lesson: Corrections are append-only; historical failures remain visible and are superseded, not rewritten.
lessons.control: v1.4 anchored LearningLedger plus supersession record in this gate
lessons.test: inherited ledger rollback, replay and tamper tests

lessons.lesson: Reuse an admitted route before building another workflow, scheduler or authority plane.
lessons.control: No new workflow; T20 tests bind into the existing allowlisted Airlock

lessons.lesson: Keep public source and private execution authority separated.
lessons.control: v1.4 executor-only effect transaction and repository Airlock
lessons.test: inherited authority and Airlock regression suites

lessons.lesson: Spreadsheet writes require native IDs, live headers, one value per field and exact semantic readback.
lessons.control: KNOWN_FAILURE_REPLAY gate includes schema-addressing recurrence

lessons.lesson: Time compliance is a separate proof gate; late success does not repair a missed deadline.
lessons.control: deadlinePass and immutable elapsedSeconds assessment

lessons.lesson: Independent challenge is required before consequential closure.
lessons.control: ADVERSARIAL_CHECK requires independent evidence

lessons.lesson: Speed improvement may be shadow-proposed only after proof-bearing regression with no quality loss.
lessons.control: omegaScientist promotionState

lessons.lesson: Unknown incremental cost and authority fail closed.
lessons.control: v1.4 authority intersection and disabled external effect adapters
lessons.test: inherited authority, provider and effect-denial tests

lessons.lesson: Adaptive intelligence routing does not prove downstream quality or savings without measured outcomes.
lessons.control: improvement remains SHADOW_CANDIDATE or HELD

lessons.lesson: Context continuity requires explicit capsules and current-state revalidation; persistence is not invisible cross-chat inheritance.
lessons.control: v1.4 handoff files and gate truth boundary

lessons.lesson: External communication language and action must match provider proof; sending requires current owner authority.
lessons.control: emailSendRule plus v1.4 gmail.send effect schema, authority intersection and Ed25519 permit

lessons.lesson: Minimize owner burden; retrieve, repair and reroute before asking the owner to perform system work.
lessons.control: NEXT_AUTOMATED_PATHWAY quality gate and mandatory next route

lessons.lesson: An incident does not end the mission; preserve evidence, repair, reroute, test, read back, learn and resume.
lessons.control: failure-recovery path plus completion state BLOCKED_WITH_EXECUTABLE_NEXT_ROUTE

lessons.lesson: Prompt-only self-audit is not enforcement; actor, verifier, authority and semantic readback must remain separable.
lessons.control: v1.4 governed graph, external permit verifier, structured evidence and independent adversarial gate
lessons.test: inherited v1.4 authority/provenance tests plus T20 evidence tests

reasons: PR 548 must pass provider-triggered Airlock, Leak Guard and Bubbles checks on the repaired head.
PR 548 is intentionally stacked on the still-open v1.4.0 foundation PR 546.
No owner authorization to merge has been given.
Gemini live binding, Workspace binding, production persistence and Cloud deployment remain unproven.
postRepairDecision.nextBestAutomatedPathway: Complete the stacked v1.5.0 source repair, retarget PR 548 to the v1.4.0 branch, run existing admission controls, and emit a provider-readback HOLD/MERGE/REPAIR receipt without changing main.
